literal_meaning: কোমরে বাঁধা মোটা কাপড় বা শাল (coarse blanket or shawl)
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে সে এক কামলা, সারাদিন খেটে রাতে ফেরে।
আজকাল কামলারা শহরে এসে নতুন কাজ খুঁজছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a day laborer in the village, working all day and returning at night.
These days, day laborers are coming to the city in search of new jobs.
history: The term originates from the practice of day laborers carrying a coarse 'kamla' blanket for protection while working in fields or construction sites in rural Bengal.
note: Refers to itinerant workers who rely on daily wages, evoking images of hardship in traditional Bengali agrarian society.
